10.2 Configuration Constraints
[SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00002]
⌈
This section lists configuration constraints for the
IdsM
Module. Instances of the container
IdsMFilterChain
always require to have
at least one filter configured (
IdsMBlockStateFilter
,
IdsMForwardEveryNth-
Filter
,
IdsMEventAggregationFilter
,
IdsMEventThresholdFilter
).
⌋
()
10.3 Published Information
For details refer to the chapter 10.3 Published Information in [3, SWS BSW General].
